//: Declaration-only emit for the PUBLISHED package. Separate from tsconfig.json, which is noEmit (typecheck/test). rootDir is `src`. Before the repo split it had to be `..`, because tsc followed payload.ts into the SIBLING shape-core sources — that emitted dist/types/{chart-host,shape-core}/src/**, which made every `types` path in the exports map wrong and left a consumer's `tsc -b` unable to find the ./react subpath's declarations. shape-core is now a real dependency, so tsc reads its .d.ts from node_modules and this tree is flat: dist/types/{index,react,geo}.d.ts. The JS half is bundled by build.mjs; this emits only .d.ts.
